title: A+ Core 1 Practice Test A
exam_focus: Core 1 (mobile, networking, hardware, virtualization/cloud, hardware/network troubleshooting)
notes: Homemade practice; not official CompTIA items. Answers balanced A-D. Grade only after all 20.

questions.stem: A workstation has IP 169.254.22.10. Which statement is most accurate?

choices.A: DHCP succeeded and assigned a private RFC1918 address
choices.B: DNS is the only service that failed
choices.C: The default gateway was configured correctly via DHCP
choices.D: The client self-assigned an APIPA address because it got no DHCP lease

questions.stem: Which IEEE standard is commonly marketed as Wi-Fi 6?
Which connector carries data for a modern internal SATA HDD/SSD?
A laser printer outputs completely blank pages. Toner is not empty. Most likely culprit?
Web-based email where the vendor patches the app and OS is primarily:
After a drop, a phone runs hot and drains fast. No new apps. Best first hardware check?

choices.B: Factory reset as the only step
choices.D: Inspect for a swollen/damaged battery and stop using if swollen

questions.stem: Two older switches without auto-MDIX need interconnect. Traditional cable?
PC fans spin, no image on a known-good monitor. Best next step?

choices.C: Check video cable/GPU seating; try onboard video if available

questions.stem: Which port is primarily associated with DNS queries?
Faulty RAM most commonly presents as:

choices.B: POST failures, beep codes, random crashes/BSODs

questions.stem: SOHO guest Wi-Fi must not reach PCs/NAS. Best approach?
RAID 1 with the minimum drives provides:
Laptop screen very dim at max brightness; external HDMI normal. Most likely?

choices.A: Laptop backlight/LED driver or display cable issue

questions.stem: Ethernet link light off; Wi-Fi works. Best first checks?

choices.D: Reseat cable, try another cable/port, check NIC in Device Manager

questions.stem: Tool that maps Ethernet pinouts and finds opens/shorts without live far-end gear?

choices.A: Loopback plug on a router WAN port
choices.B: Toner probe with no toner generator

questions.stem: Laptop won't charge. Adapter LED on; known-good battery tried. Next hardware focus?

choices.D: BIOS update as the only step

questions.stem: You rent VMs/storage/networking and install/manage the OS yourself. This is:
Secure remote CLI admin to a Linux server typically uses:
Memory form factor typical for a modern full-size desktop motherboard?
New GPU installed; system won't POST. Best early check?

choices.A: Verify PCIe power connectors seated and PSU capacity; reseat GPU
choices.B: Ignore PSU wattage and keep troubleshooting software
